pr_body:
The purpose for this change is to allow validation of queries without
having to actually execute them. The optimizer already picks up this
case.

Fix #62494

issue_context.title: EQL: Support size 0 for query validation

review_comments: Shouldn't this be `randomIntBetween(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE)`? or maybe to cover better the 0 scenario - a `randomBoolean()` to choose between `size` 0 and `size` between 1 and MAX.
